ideas.title: Voice interface to Hermes on a wrist device
ideas.context: Discussing why Notes.app and notebooks fail for idea capture — the capture medium must be the thinking medium. Stuart: "I would eventually like a voice interface to you on my wrist."

ideas.title: Pocket Voice Memo Recorder (Hermes Dropbox)
ideas.context: Idea about a dedicated hardware device — handheld, USB-C charging, single button (press-hold to record, release to save), no screen, no notifications, zero distraction. Records offline while out and about. When back on home WiFi (or plugged in via USB-C), auto-dumps recordings to Hermes Agent for transcription, execution, and processing. Potential for Bluetooth or LoRa extension for connectivity beyond home network.

ideas.title: User-driven web UI module
ideas.context: An AI-powered modular interface system where website visitors can reorganize, remap, and customize their view of any website using an AI chat. Default UI is the fallback; advanced users can drag modules, edit markup, save layouts to local storage or account. All internal content/product data is protected from injection. Concept applies to Amazon, Reddit, any platform.

ideas.title: Economic cycles and musical innovation
ideas.context: Study historical economic boom/bust cycles alongside concurrent musical genres and innovations. Hypothesis: music reflects societal mood and sentiment that tracks economic conditions. What patterns emerge across cycles? What can we learn about where we are now by looking at music? Requires multi-cycle historical analysis.

ideas.title: The correlation between economic, boom bust, cycles, and musical innovation
ideas.context: Throughout the ages, music is a mirror and a reflection to reality society and its ideals, sorrows joys.
